title: Dominus SMP
description: An economical server focused on RPG elements, interactive NPCs that disappear at night, quests, and much more.
body:
🌎 **Dominus SMP**

We are an economical server with an RP focus.

📜​ Features:
We have systems of **clans, kingdoms, kings, shops, and missions**.

We have **Data Packs** that improve gameplay, such as _new biomes_, _new structures_, _new end/nether, flags, etc._

We make **frequent updates**, focusing on quality of life and improving gameplay, doing everything possible to improve the game.
